results.title: Sarah A. Schnitker, Ph.D. - Baylor Psychology and Neuroscience
results.content: Dr. Sarah Schnitker is a Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience at Baylor University. She holds a Ph.D. and an MA in Personality and Social Psychology from the University of California, Davis, and a BA in Psychology from Grove City College. Schnitker studies virtue and character development in adolescents and emerging adults, with a focus on the role of spirituality and religion in virtue formation. Schnitker is an Associate Editor for *Psychology of Religion and Spirituality,* an Editorial Board member for *Journal of Research in Personality,* and a co-editor of the *Handbook of Positive Psychology, Religion, and Spirituality*. *Psychology of Religion and Spirituality*. *International Journal of Applied Positive Psychology, 10*(1), 26. *The Journal of Positive Psychology, 19*(3), 406-418. *Philosophical Psychology, 37*(8), 2597-2622*.* https://doi.org/10.1080/09515089.2023.2203157. International Positive Psychology Association Spirituality and Meaning Division Researcher Award, 2025. Fellow of the American Psychological Association (Division 36), 2023-present. International Positive Psychology Association SIPPA Mentor Award, 2021. Dr. Schnitker is currently accepting applications for Ph.D. students. ## Department of Psychology and Neuroscience.
